prior_incidents.reason: registry_version 2's captures for these three cases were generated by materializing one prompt-package directory per CASE, shared across both config-a and config-b, so both sub-agents wrote RAW_RESPONSE to the same path and one silently overwrote the other before either byte stream was read. The overwritten (first) invocation's raw bytes are unrecoverably lost -- see benchmarks/agent_quality/invalidated/<case-id>/lost-generation-attempts/ for the honest incident records -- and the surviving official captures under registry_version 2 were themselves a SECOND invocation, violating registry_version 2's own one_attempt_only/no_retry invariants. Both the surviving registry_version 2 captures and the lost first attempts are withdrawn; registry_version 3 adds unique_prompt_directory_per_invocation, output_directory_must_not_preexist, and exclusive_directory_creation specifically to make this class of defect structurally impossible, not merely disclosed after the fact.
